verdict.rationale: Perplexity documents version pinning for effort levels and presets (e.g. `fast@2026-10-16.0`), so callers can keep running one released configuration after the default moves on. It also documents versioned profiles, and notes that Sonar requests are being reformulated as Agent API requests while continuing to work. No formal deprecation policy (notice periods, sunset timelines) or versioned API endpoints are documented. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation/sunset policy with timelines, explicit API endpoint versioning scheme, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: call an effort level with a version (e.g., `effort="fast@2026-10-16.0"`) to keep running one released configuration after the effort level moves on.
A profile is a reusable, versioned configuration that you save and manage.
Synchronous and streaming requests keep working: they are being reformulated as Agent API requests, rolling out gradually by model.
